intro: Every place you sell has its own screen shape and its own habits. Vertical feeds like TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts want full-screen 9:16 clips, Facebook and Instagram feeds suit a square, and Amazon and Shopify run on clean product photos. The pages below cover six channels: the video sizes and lengths we can make for each, square photos for listings, practical tips, and ideas you can try with one product photo. When a clip or image is ready, you download it and upload it wherever you sell.

faq.q: Can one vertical video work on TikTok, Reels and Shorts?
faq.a: Yes, a 9:16 file fits all three. Each app places its buttons and captions a little differently, so look at the clip in each one before you spend money behind it.

faq.q: Do you post the finished ads to my accounts?
faq.a: No. You download the video or photo and upload it yourself, whether that's in an ad account, your Shopify admin or your Amazon listing.

faq.q: Which platform should I start with?
faq.a: Start where your customers already buy from you. If most orders come through your own store, begin with product photos; if you run paid social ads, begin with a vertical clip.
